bullets.title: Bumble
bullets.note:
This is a godsend. If you’re single, this app turns things upside-down in
the best way possible. It’s similar to Tinder, but the onus is on the women.
If you (a male) match with someone (a female), the woman must message you
within 24 hours or your match expires and you disappear. This tweak is good
for everyone’s sanity, saves 90%+ of the time wasting, and produces faster
matches than I’ve seen anywhere else. Have any funny Bumble stories? I’d love
to hear ‘em ([tweet
@tferriss](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=w61&mc=e&s=bomwH&u=w&y=D&)
with #bumble), and I have no connection with the company. Just a fan.
